title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-09
source: SBD (shn ID 172) with AUD patch by Monte Barry.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a strong performance with the memorable Truckin' conversation before slipping into Playin!'
ai_review.review: The recording delivers great, clear sound and showcases a solid show, highlighted by the on‑stage “conversation” at the end of Truckin' when Jerry tries to slip in a tease of “Here Comes Sunshine” before the band lands on Playin!.  Overall the performance feels energetic and tightly executed.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it praises both the audio fidelity and the strong musical delivery, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, strong sound with no reported issues; reviewers describe it as “great sound.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: Notable on‑stage conversation at the end of Truckin' (around 11 min) where Jerry tries a Here Comes Sunshine tease before moving into Playin!.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Attempted to segue into “Here Comes Sunshine” during Truckin', showing his spontaneous direction; overruled but noted as a memorable moment.
